nodes.label: Brand DNA (al-Raqim thesis)
nodes.rationale: Name derived from al-Raqim, the inscribed tablet of the Companions of the Cave; RAQIM is framed as being in the business of permanence, not content, for a female reader.

nodes.label: Editorial Identity (publishing house, not marketplace)
nodes.rationale: RAQIM behaves like a curatorial publishing house rather than a marketplace; every title carries a point of view instead of being merely listed.

nodes.label: Luxury Positioning (care, not decoration)
nodes.rationale: Luxury is defined as visible evidence of care (editing, considered covers, real translation) in a category flooded with disposable content — costs restraint, not decoration.

nodes.label: Reading-First Experience
nodes.rationale: The product's job is to shorten the distance between arrival and calm, absorbed reading; it is a reading experience that happens to have a storefront attached.

nodes.label: Arabic Typography Philosophy
nodes.rationale: Arabic is the native language, not a localization; its own vertical rhythm, connective letterforms, and line-height relationships must be designed from first decisions, not adapted from Latin assumptions.

nodes.label: Color Philosophy (V1)
nodes.rationale: Low-saturation palette signals maturity over trend; gold functions like a gilt edge or wax seal reserved for genuine emphasis, never a decorative wash.

nodes.label: Motion Language (V1)
nodes.rationale: Every motion must have a plausible physical analogy (a page turning, a breath, light shifting); timing scales with the size of the change it communicates.

nodes.label: Dashboard Experience Philosophy (V1)
nodes.rationale: The admin dashboard is the desk where a solo founder runs the business; calmness there is infrastructure, not decoration, because dashboard stress leaks into the reader's experience.

nodes.label: Component Philosophy (V1)
nodes.rationale: Describes intent per component family (buttons as decision points, cards as a shelf spine, forms as a notebook page) without specifying tokens or implementation.
